inputs: All 34 8-byte-key Blowfish ECB vectors from draft-schneier-blowfish-00 §4
expected: Every encryption matches the listed ciphertext and every decryption returns the plaintext
limitations: 34 fixed vectors with 8-byte keys only; two rows are the same zero key/plaintext, so there are 33 distinct input pairs. They do not cover every key length or plaintext.

inputs: Fixed plaintext 1111111111111111 and keys of 4, 8, 16, 24, 32 and 56 bytes
expected: Every ciphertext decrypts back to the plaintext
limitations: Fixed data and six key lengths; not a random or exhaustive key-length test. 56 bytes is the 448-bit maximum.

inputs: The pi-derived initial P-array and S-boxes generated by the teaching script
limitations: Checks selected initial entries; the 34 known-answer vectors validate the full tables indirectly.

inputs: Zero key, plaintext 0000000000000000 and the same plaintext with the low bit of its right 32-bit word flipped (0000000000000001)
limitations: One fixed one-bit difference; it is a diffusion observation, not a differential probability or a security proof.
One short key and its doubled form; the general equivalence follows from key cycling, not from testing every key.
